user.title: Connect to a HAWB PC
user.description: In HAWB's settings, open Connection and turn on "Home Assistant integration". Normally Home Assistant finds the PC by itself; use this form only if it did not.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: In HAWB's settings on that PC, open Connection → Home Assistant integration and press "Show pairing code". Type the six digits here.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again with {name}
reauth_confirm.description: This PC no longer accepts Home Assistant (the pairing was removed). Press "Show pairing code" in HAWB's settings and type the code here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach HAWB on that PC. Check that HAWB is running, the integration is turned on and the firewall allows it.
error.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired. Show a new code in HAWB and try again.

abort.already_configured: This PC is already set up
abort.not_hawb: That is not a HAWB agent

send_rich_notification.name: Send rich notification
send_rich_notification.description: Shows a Windows notification with an optional image, icon, buttons and reply box.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Sending another notification with the same tag replaces the first.

reply.name: Reply box
reply.description: Show a reply box (true, or the placeholder text).

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Up to five buttons, each with an action id and a title. Presses arrive on the PC's Notification action event entity.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Remove the notification with this tag instead of showing one.
